title: Sinn Fein
html_source:
Modern Sinn Féin.

Sinn Féin were a Nationalist turn of the century party :

Whilst not being gibberish, this sentence makes little sense even through the allusion.

The first two sentences are relatively clear in the context of his argument about the effect people around Shakespeare had on him. This sentence is either nervous banter or a slight at Sinn Féin comparing them to the judges in Athens who would put the Hoi polloi before justice and reasoned argument.
